args.title: Fix currency merging in exported CSV for identical transactions
args.body: This pull request addresses a bug reported in issue #4206, where transactions with the same date, amount, and description but differing currencies (such as EUR and USD) were being merged in the exported CSV file generated by `src/export/csv.ts`. The CSV writer was inadvertently treating these transactions as identical and excluding one from the final output. The fix will ensure that all transactions are exported correctly without merging those with different currencies.
